items.title: Canonical ingress must be durably journaled before authoritative delivery
evidence: Production composition supplies StoreIngressJournal backed by Store.appendAuditEvent.
SQLite worker acknowledges append only after COMMIT; configured database uses WAL and synchronous=FULL.

A module-private Store capability checks the live worker database path, WAL mode, and synchronous=FULL; overriding the old public check method on Store(':memory:') does not grant a durable ingress capability.
CanonicalIngress rejects caller-supplied journals before creating or notifying a CommittedEnvelope.
test/platform/canonical-ingress-durability.test.mjs verifies memory-store rejection, arbitrary-journal rejection, commit-before-notification, and duplicate recognition after reopen.
Research cycle 134 added canonical_ingress_delivery_v1 as a SQLite outbox committed atomically with the canonical ingress event; recovery revalidates stored payloads before redispatch.

Crash-recovery test now proves pending delivery survives reopen and audit pruning, is replayed on duplicate submit, and is removed only after durable acknowledgement; delivered dedupe survives pruning.
npm run audit:c1 now reports C1-C4 PASS with all physical stopping metrics zero and runtime tests passing.
remaining: Independent review of the current outbox transaction, replay and compatibility semantics.
Delivery remains at-least-once: make downstream state mutation idempotent or atomically checkpoint it with acknowledgement before claiming exactly-once effects.
items.nextAction: Obtain independent review, then prove downstream idempotency under crash-after-effect/before-ack.

items.title: Provider raw evidence is not uniformly wire-preserved
evidence: WebSocket path stores the received JSON-RPC frame bytes.
Yellowstone SDK exposes a decoded protobuf update; implementation stores a JSON serialization of that decoded update, not original protobuf wire bytes.
remaining: Document protobuf SDK boundary and add a versioned canonical binary encoding or capture wire bytes before SDK decoding.
items.nextAction: Determine whether Yellowstone transport API exposes original frame bytes; otherwise retain explicit decoded-evidence classification.

items.title: Current truth validator does not independently prove Solana transaction authenticity
evidence: DefaultTruthValidator verifies payload digest and metadata shape.
signatureVerified is now always false; the validator still cannot establish cryptographic signature or finalized transaction evidence.

schemaCompliant is now false for generic/test compilers and true only for the versioned Solana compiler with decoded events; that compiler path still does not establish chain inclusion or signature authenticity.
remaining: Replace this claim with independently verified transaction inclusion/execution evidence or mark authenticity unavailable and keep dependent authority gated.
items.nextAction: Define and implement evidence semantics consistent with saved Solana Simulation Evidence and CPI trace research.

items.title: Engine still owns Feed construction, though its journal construction now fails closed
evidence: runEngine explicitly constructs and injects Store-backed ingress and Feed.
Engine no longer falls back to InMemoryIngressJournal and requires explicit Store-backed ingress or an injected test ingress.
Engine's ingress and committed handler are JavaScript private, and Engine no longer exposes an ingress getter.
Feed ingress is JavaScript private.
Engine continues to construct Feed when no Feed is injected; full RuntimeComposition ownership remains incomplete.
remaining: Move Feed construction out of Engine into RuntimeComposition.
items.nextAction: Inventory and migrate Engine constructors without introducing a test-only production fallback.

items.title: Committed ingress delivery is memory-only and can be lost or partially replayed
evidence: SQLite canonical_ingress_delivery_v1 persists the committed payload and acknowledgement state in the same database as the ingress audit journal.
Recovery on startup and duplicate submit revalidates and redispatches unacknowledged rows; pruning retains unacknowledged rows and stable dedupe records.
test/platform/canonical-ingress-crash-recovery.test.mjs passes crash/reopen, prune-before-replay, replay, acknowledgement, and prune-after-ack cases.
remaining: The outbox is at-least-once. If a downstream handler applies an effect and the process dies before acknowledgement, the effect may be applied again.
Make authoritative downstream handlers idempotent or persist an atomic checkpoint with delivery acknowledgement; add crash-after-effect-before-ack verification.
items.nextAction: Audit downstream handlers and add durable idempotency keys/checkpoints before claiming exactly-once effects.

items.title: Physical auditor must require commit-to-delivery crash recovery before C1
evidence: npm run audit:c1 rebuilt current TypeScript and executed source analysis, negative compilation guards, and physical runtime integration checks.
Current audit reports C1-C4 PASS, all listed stopping metrics zero, and RUNTIME_TESTS_PASSED true.

The separate C0-C10 connectivity compiler remains conservative and reports only C1: it lacks a source-bound test-run receipt and sees only 2/4 authority paths from src/fusion.ts. This distinct graph gate is tracked separately; the physical auditor result does not override it.
items.nextAction: Keep the physical auditor source-bound and preserve the separate static graph limitations in certification output.

items.title: Current core suite is not green on shared worktree
evidence: The latest repository-wide npm run test:all passed core 531/531, intelligence 561/561, platform 909/909, and terminal 309/309 (2,310 total; zero failures).
The full run completed after rebuilding current TypeScript and after the durable ingress recovery, in-memory test-journal acknowledgement, Feed fixture, and C5 attestation changes.
items.nextAction: Rerun the complete suite after future source changes; maintain a machine-readable source-bound test receipt for certification.

items.title: C0-C10 certification static baseline remains C1 despite physical C1-C4 auditor pass
evidence: npm run audit:connectivity:static reports 668 TypeScript modules, zero compile diagnostics, but no current-source test-run receipt; therefore its system highestProvenLevel is C1.
From src/fusion.ts, the configured static graph reaches only canonicalStateWriter and economicStateWriter; decisionIssuer and terminalityIssuer are unreachable in the import graph.
npm run audit:convergence:certify therefore halts at C4_GATE_HALT with baseline C1, before loading runtime evidence.
remaining: Create and validate a passing test-run receipt bound to current source inventory, exact command/test set, runtime version and exit status.
Trace actual composition and connect only real producer-consumer imports/dependencies; do not add unused imports to inflate graph reachability.
items.nextAction: Implement source-bound receipt generation and review the two unreachable authority paths against production composition.

items.title: Runtime telemetry requires authenticated attestation and a connected producer
evidence: C5 certify mode no longer accepts caller-provided runtimeTelemetry objects and requires the fixed persisted artifact path.
Schema and canonical hash alone do not prove a REAL_RUNTIME origin. The verifier now requires an Ed25519 signature over the telemetry payload and a pinned runtime attestation public key.
config/certification-config.json currently has no runtime attestation trust root; no runtime telemetry artifact or connected producer is present, so C5 cannot pass.

The attestation validates provenance only relative to an operator-provisioned key; the producer must bind actual process identity, current source identity and a verifiable SQLite FSYNC_COMMITTED event.
remaining: Provision the runtime attestation public key through reviewed deployment configuration.
Connect an instrumented runtime producer that signs spans and a durable-event receipt; verify the referenced SQLite record rather than accepting caller-entered IDs/hashes.
items.nextAction: Implement the runtime-side signed evidence producer and independent durable-record lookup; keep C5 unawarded until then.
